{{Top|leg}}
The '''Rubogean Gambit''' was a political maneuver in which one party made a provocative statement to an opponent, in an effort to distract the opponent and make them so upset they were unable to discern the other's true motives.<ref name="TCSWE">''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] used this move at a [[Jedi Convocation]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the [[Dark Nest Crisis]]<ref name="SW">''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]''</ref> in [[36 ABY]],<ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Dark Nest III: The Swarm War]]'' to [[36 ABY/Legends|36 ABY]].</ref> asking every [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] to rethink their commitment to the [[New Jedi Order|Order]]. This was to distract them so they would have trouble noticing Luke's power play in becoming Jedi [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]].<ref name="SW" />
